title: monthly-micro-qbr-readiness-kit-for-platform-and-engops
creator: Sofia Morales
description: Create a repeatable, concise 'Micro-QBR' one-pager and ops readiness kit tailored for Platform & EngOps stakeholders to support monthly executive readouts. The deliverable is a templated artifact and an accompanying runbook that reduces prep time for monthly checkpoints from multiple days to under 4 hours while surfacing high-signal operational telemetry, risk lanes, and clear escalation/rollback instructions. This ticket covers the template, automated data pulls (dash links), Slack notification/playbook, and a dry-run with the platform release team.
acceptance_criteria: A1: One-pager template completed with sections: objective, topline metric bullets, top-3 risks with mitigation status, recent incidents & learnings, rollout/rollback checklist, ask for execs.
A2: Runbook created that lists step-by-step prep tasks, owners, and a 60/30/15 minute pre-read checklist.
A3: Data pipeline links validated: latency/cost dashboard, availability SLO panel, key customer query traffic snapshot; URLs included in template.
A4: Slack workflow (channel + pinned checklist + reviewer assignment) implemented and tested in #engops-staging with success signal.
A5: Two dry-run readouts executed (internal) and feedback incorporated into final template.
A6: Stakeholder sign-off from Product Director and Platform Eng Manager.

decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use a single-page micro-QBR rather than expanding to multi-page decks to reduce exec review time and encourage asynchronous comments.
Trade-off: Limited space means only top-3 risks are surfaced — lower-priority risks moved to linked artifact in Confluence.
Decision: Surface 95th latency, error-rate, and cost per 1k tokens as the topline metrics (selected for balance between performance and economics).
risks: Dependency on analytics team for dashboard snippets may delay dry-runs; mitigated by a fallback manual CSV snapshot process.
Execs may request deeper technical detail during readout—prepare a 5-slide appendix with deep-dive links.
If Slack workflow fails, notification cadence for reviewers could be missed; plan B is email + calendar invite automation.

Suggested follow-up: quarterly retrospective of Micro-QBRs to validate signal selection and reduce noise.
